EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.title: Define Weight Configuration Schema and Contract
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.description: Define schema including weight bounds, normalization strategy (sum=1 or auto-scale), measure keys aligned to scoring engines, and optional user/session persistence contract.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.evidence: GAP: No weighting schema or persistence model exists; required to enable adjustable scoring inputs

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Logic
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.description: Implement deterministic weighting pipeline with normalization, default fallback, and missing-measure handling; ensure identical behavior for provider and trial engines.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Scoring engines accept per-measure inputs; extend evaluate_care_facade.py and clinical_trials_service.py to apply weights deterministically

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.title: Expose Weight Configuration API and UI Controls
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.description: Expose endpoints (get/set/reset) and UI controls; include immediate recompute trigger and idempotent updates; support session-level persistence.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.evidence: GAP: No API endpoints or frontend components exist for user preference capture or persistence

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Weighting System
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.description: Unit tests for schema + normalization; integration tests validating end-to-end recompute parity across providers and trials with edge cases.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for weighting behavior; must extend backend test suite under backend/tests/

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.description: Inject weights into evaluate_care_facade request flow and ensure all responses reflect weighted scores with backward-compatible defaults.
